description: Search WHO publications and official documents — guidelines, technical reports, World Health Reports, weekly epidemiological records and governing-body papers — by topic, disease, author or title. Returns each publication with its title, authors, publication date, document type, MeSH subjects, abstract and a permanent link. Use to find what the World Health Organization has actually published on a health topic.

page.description: Zero-based page number for paging through results.

query.description: Topic, disease, title words or author, e.g. "tuberculosis treatment guidelines".
